mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness that triggers Fed policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicates sustainable economic expansion, reducing recession risk and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month moving average and RSAFS > 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 signals economic contraction that prompts Fed monetary easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation below 1.5% indicates disinflationary pressures that reduce premature rate hike risks, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth above the 12-month average sustains consumer spending momentum, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds the 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 750,000 annual units signal strong consumer confidence and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 750.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate below 0.5% and CPI inflation below 2.0% indicates stable monetary conditions that support equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%.
